cues.en: In our architecture.
cues.zh: 在我們的架構中，

cues.en: Various client requests from platforms such as web, mobile, etc. will not be sent directly to the fast API server.
cues.zh: 來自網頁、行動裝置等平台的各種用戶端請求，不會直接送到 FastAPI 伺服器。

cues.en: Instead, the requests are going to be sent to our gateway layer, which is going to be running traffic as a Docker service.
cues.zh: 請求會先送到閘道層，而這一層會以 Docker 服務執行 Traefik。

cues.en: This shall be the entry point for all the client requests.
cues.zh: 這會是所有用戶端請求的進入點。

cues.en: Traffic is an open source reverse proxy and ingress controller that makes deploying services and APIs easy.
cues.zh: Traefik 是開源的反向代理與入口控制器，可讓服務及 API 的部署更容易。

cues.en: We're going to be using traffic first as a reverse proxy, meaning it will receive requests on behalf of our system and then route this request to appropriate services responsible for handling the requests.
cues.zh: 首先，我們會把 Traefik 當成反向代理，代表系統接收請求，再將請求導向負責處理的適當服務。

cues.en: We're also going to be using traffic as a load balancer.
cues.zh: 我們也會把 Traefik 當成負載平衡器。

cues.en: A load balancer is a system that distributes incoming network traffic across multiple servers to ensure no single server is overwhelmed.
cues.zh: 負載平衡器會將傳入的網路流量分散到多部伺服器，確保單一伺服器不會負荷過重。

cues.en: We shall be using the default round robin algorithm with round robin requests a distributed sequentially across servers.
cues.zh: 我們會使用預設的輪詢演算法，以輪詢方式依序將請求分配給各部伺服器。

cues.en: Then we're also going to be using traffic to handle encryption and security via Https, thus ensuring that our network traffic is encrypted.
cues.zh: 另外也會用 Traefik 透過 HTTPS 處理加密與安全性，確保網路流量受到加密。

cues.en: And the next we're going to have the application layer where our first API server is going to live.
cues.zh: 接著是應用程式層，FastAPI 伺服器就位於這裡。

cues.en: Also running as a Docker container.
cues.zh: 同樣會以 Docker 容器執行。

cues.en: This shall be the service with the core business logic and API endpoints.
cues.zh: 這個服務包含核心商業邏輯與 API 端點。

cues.en: We're going to have an oath module that is going to handle user registration, login with OTP password resets and cookie based JWT auth.
cues.zh: 我們會有驗證模組，處理使用者註冊、使用一次性密碼登入、重設密碼，以及以 Cookie 為基礎的 JWT 驗證。

cues.en: Then you're going to have the bank account module that manages account creation and management.
cues.zh: 接著是銀行帳戶模組，負責帳戶建立與管理。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a transaction module that handles transactions such as deposits, withdrawals,
cues.zh: 交易模組則處理存款、提款，

cues.en: currency conversions, transfers, etc. then a profile module that is going to handle user profile information and KYC verification.
cues.zh: 貨幣轉換、轉帳等交易。個人資料模組會處理使用者個人資料與 KYC 身分驗證。

cues.en: Then you're going to have an AI fraud detection module, which is going to be used for real time transaction risk analysis and fraud detection, and shall be explaining the machine learning module in more detail
cues.zh: 還有 AI 詐欺偵測模組，用於即時交易風險分析與詐欺偵測。我會進一步介紹機器學習模組，

cues.en: in the next video.
cues.zh: 就在下一支影片。

cues.en: Then you're going to have a virtual card module for our virtual visa card issuance and management.
cues.zh: 另有虛擬卡模組，用來發行與管理我們的虛擬 Visa 卡。

cues.en: Then moving forward, we're going to have a data storage layer that is going to be running Postgres as a Docker container.
cues.zh: 再來是資料儲存層，Postgres 會以 Docker 容器執行。

cues.en: This layer is going to be used for persistent data storage.
cues.zh: 這一層用於持久儲存資料。

cues.en: We're going to be setting up a primary database, which is going to store all our data using Postgres.
cues.zh: 我們會設定主要資料庫，以 Postgres 儲存所有資料。

cues.en: The data models we shall have is going to include the user profile, bank account transaction, next of kin virtual card and the machine learning models.
cues.zh: 資料模型會包括使用者、個人資料、銀行帳戶、交易、近親、虛擬卡，以及機器學習模型。

cues.en: Then we're also going to have a support services layer.
cues.zh: 另外也有支援服務層。

cues.en: And here we're going to be using Milpitas and Mailgun for email sending over notifications and one time passwords.
cues.zh: 這裡會使用 Mailpit 與 Mailgun，寄送通知與一次性密碼等電子郵件。

cues.en: Then we shall use Cloudinary.
cues.zh: 接著會用 Cloudinary。

cues.en: We're going to be using Cloudinary for cloud storage, for user profile images and other documents such as bank statements.
cues.zh: Cloudinary 提供雲端儲存，用來存放使用者個人照片與銀行對帳單等其他文件。

cues.en: The next we're going to have an asynchronous services layer which is going to be this.
cues.zh: 接著是這裡的非同步服務層。

cues.en: These services are also going to be running as a Docker container.
cues.zh: 這些服務也會以 Docker 容器執行。

cues.en: This layer shall handle all the asynchronous and scheduled tasks.
cues.zh: 這一層處理所有非同步工作與排程工作。

cues.en: We're going to have a salary workers that are going to handle asynchronous and background tasks that shouldn't block the main application flow.
cues.zh: 我們會有 Celery worker，處理不應阻塞主要應用程式流程的非同步與背景工作。

cues.en: They will process background jobs like email, sending, PDF generation of transaction histories, machine learning, training, etc. then we're going to have the salary bit scheduler that is going to help in
cues.zh: 它們會處理寄送電子郵件、產生交易歷史 PDF、訓練機器學習模型等背景工作。接著是 Celery beat 排程器，協助

cues.en: scheduling periodic tasks like daily machine learning, training, etc. then we're also going to be setting up a flower.
cues.zh: 安排每日機器學習訓練等週期性工作。另外也會設定 Flower，

cues.en: Monitoring a flower is a tool that is going to help us monitor the celery task, execution and performance using a web interface.
cues.zh: 作為監控工具。Flower 透過網頁介面，協助監控 Celery 工作的執行與效能。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a caching and messaging layer.
cues.zh: 接著是快取與訊息傳遞層。

cues.en: Here.
cues.zh: 在這裡，

cues.en: We're going to set up support services for data management by using Redis and RabbitMQ.
cues.zh: 我們會透過 Redis 與 RabbitMQ，建立資料管理所需的支援服務。

cues.en: We're going to be using Redis for caching.
cues.zh: Redis 用來快取資料。

cues.en: We shall also use the same radius as celery backend result storage and also use Redis for rate limiting.
cues.zh: 同一個 Redis 也會作為 Celery 的結果儲存後端，並用於速率限制。

cues.en: Then we're going to be using RabbitMQ as a message broker for celery task management.
cues.zh: RabbitMQ 則作為訊息代理，管理 Celery 工作。

cues.en: Then lastly we're going to have our machine learning layer.
cues.zh: 最後是機器學習層。

cues.en: Here is where we're going to define our transaction analysis and fraud detection machine learning services.
cues.zh: 我們會在這裡定義交易分析與詐欺偵測的機器學習服務。

cues.en: We shall use an MLflow server to track machine learning experiments, to manage model versions and to deploy models.
cues.zh: 使用 MLflow 伺服器追蹤機器學習實驗、管理模型版本，以及部署模型。

cues.en: We are also going to be setting up a machine learning training pipeline to train and evaluate fraud detection models.
cues.zh: 我們也會建立機器學習訓練管線，訓練並評估詐欺偵測模型。

cues.en: That's it for the overall system architecture.
cues.zh: 整體系統架構就介紹到這裡。

cues.en: In the next video, we shall discuss in a bit more detail the machine learning pipeline architecture.
cues.zh: 下一支影片會更詳細討論機器學習管線架構。
